sub_limits_waiting_notes: Morbid obesity: 36 months. Correction of refractive error: 24 months. Infertility: 24 months continuous coverage. Mental Illnesses Depression and Schizophrenia: 2 years.

inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Plan A has per-day room/ICU sub-limit; Plan B/C have higher caps; no sub-limit in Preferred Provider Network packaged procedures

day_care_treatments.notes: Less than 24 hours hospitalization at hospital or day care centre

domiciliary_treatment.limit_text: Up to limit shown in Table of Benefits
domiciliary_treatment.notes: Excludes asthma, bronchitis, epilepsy, gastroenteritis, psychiatric disorders, etc.

maternity_coverage.limit_text: Up to Table of Benefits limit (varies by Plan)
maternity_coverage.notes: 24-month waiting period. Female covered 18-45 years. Max 2 deliveries/terminations lifetime. Includes Pre-Natal and Post-Natal hospitalisation, newborn vaccination.

newborn_coverage.limit_text: Auto-covered under mother's SI for 3 months from birth
newborn_coverage.notes: After 3 months, requires policy mid-term inclusion and premium

organ_donor_expenses.notes: Per Transplantation of Human Organs Act 1994; excludes pre/post hospitalization of donor, organ acquisition, transportation

ambulance_cover.limit_text: Up to Table of Benefits limit
ambulance_cover.notes: Road ambulance; air ambulance also covered separately

critical_illness_cover.limit_text: Optional cover on payment of additional premium
critical_illness_cover.notes: Critical Illness available as optional cover

restoration_benefit.limit_text: Reinstatement of Sum Insured if exhausted due to Road Traffic Accident

preventive_health_checkup.limit_text: Reimbursed at end of every block of two continuous policy years
preventive_health_checkup.notes: Subject to continuous renewal without break

room_rent_capping: Plan A: per Table of Benefits per-day limit; Plan B/C: higher caps. No cap if treated in PPN packaged listed procedure.
icu_capping: Plan A: per Table of Benefits per-day limit; Plan B/C: higher caps. No cap if treated in PPN packaged listed procedure.
copayment_trigger_notes: Optional Co-payment: 20% with 25% premium discount or 10% with 12.5% premium discount.

disease_wise_sub_limits.cataract: As per Table of Benefits (Plan A only) - limit applies
disease_wise_sub_limits.hazardous_sports: Lower of 25% of SI per any one illness

permanent_exclusions: Rest Cure, Rehabilitation and Respite Care (Excl 05)
notable_exclusions_summary: Standard IRDAI exclusions: cosmetic surgery, change-of-gender, hazardous sports, self-inflicted injury, drug/alcohol abuse, unproven treatments, refractive error <7.5D, war, radioactivity, and treatment outside India. Time-bound: 30-day initial wait, 36-month PED wait, 24-month maternity and infertility wait.
claim_process_summary: Cashless via TPA (request form to TPA, pre-authorisation within 1 hour, final auth within 3 hours). Reimbursement: notify within 24-72 hours; submit documents within 30 days of discharge. Claim settled within 15 days of last necessary document.
